technical_and_design_decisions: U1 performance testing will leverage the existing Spring XD performance test harness to avoid developing new test infrastructure.
Reactor 2.0.3 migration will follow the official Project Reactor migration guide with no custom patches to the Reactor library.
JMX disablement will be implemented via a top-level xd.jmx.enabled configuration property that defaults to false, preserving backward compatibility for explicitly enabled JMX deployments.
U4 build fixes will be limited to Gradle task configuration adjustments with no changes to underlying dependency versions or core build logic.
U6 multi-instance RPM support will use instance-specific configuration directories and unique PID file paths following standard Linux service patterns to avoid instance conflicts.
U7 and U8 documentation updates will use the existing Asciidoctor documentation framework with no changes to the documentation build pipeline.
assumptions: Provisioned Kafka 0.8.1 and 0.8.2 test clusters for U1 are accessible from the development environment and have identical topology to eliminate environment-related performance variance.
The existing Spring XD codebase has no hard dependencies on Reactor versions older than 2.0.3, so the upgrade will not require changes to third-party dependencies beyond Reactor itself.
A base RPM init script for xd-container already exists, so U6 work only requires modifications for multi-instance support rather than a full script rewrite.
All content for OOTB batch job and analytics tab documentation already exists in draft or legacy form, so only navigation, cross-referencing, and formatting updates are required.
U4 build issues are limited to Gradle task configuration errors with no underlying dependency conflicts or missing artifacts requiring additional resolution.
